A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UniSite dataset, framework, and evaluation work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated supplementary material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations of UniSite-1D/3D, sequence-similarity and query-count ablations, and a VN-EGNN radius analysis.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds quantitative metric diagnostics and recall evaluations on HOLO4K-sc.

M1.justification: The sequence/structure encoders, transformer decoder, site queries, segmentation outputs, and Hungarian-matched training remain unchanged. The three-layer input MLP is newly documented, while the BCE/Dice combination and classification weight made explicit in Section 3.1 were already specified in v1 Section 5.1.

E1.justification: Both versions use UniSite-DS, HOLO4K-sc, and COACH420, with the same reported dataset composition. New diagnostics reuse HOLO4K-sc. Appendix B documents curation exclusions without establishing a change to the dataset or evaluated task coverage.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators remain Fpocket, Fpocket-rescore, P2Rank, DeepPocket, GrASP, and VN-EGNN. Appendix D explains their selection and output processing. Newly cited ProtDETR is discussed but not evaluated.

E3.justification: Existing splits, training settings, and benchmark metrics are retained. New supplementary protocols evaluate double-counting, ground-truth residue centroids, DCC-residue, and recall at IoU thresholds 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9 on HOLO4K-sc.

E4.justification: Appendices G and I substantially extend the analysis through quantitative double-counting audits, ground-truth centroid checks, comparison with DCC-residue, and a recall threshold sweep. Appendix B adds two curation case studies. Existing similarity, query-count, radius, and classical-method analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new double-counting percentages and mean centroid distances are descriptive results, not uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Original benchmark and ablation scores are unchanged, but new Tables S1, S2, and S4 substantially expand the findings. Added results include DCC double-counting rates of 8.88–18.98%, DCC-residue comparisons, and UniSite-3D recall of 0.8469, 0.6901, 0.4106, and 0.1039 at the four tested IoU thresholds.

T1.justification: Appendix G introduces DCC-residue, replacing the ligand center with the ground-truth residue centroid in the distance definition, and adds reasoning about ligand-dependent evaluation errors. The original matching and loss framework remains; no theorems or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and concluding contribution summary retain the same central claims: a UniProt-centric dataset, end-to-end UniSite-1D/3D detection, IoU-based AP evaluation, and superior benchmark performance. Added supporting analyses do not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: The new conclusion acknowledges manual-curation limitations and proposes recovering excluded data. Appendix B explains boundaries involving supramolecular assemblies and ambiguous composite cavities. Appendices G and I add interpretations of centroid-based evaluation and the distinction between high recall and useful confidence ranking.

D1.justification: v2 substantially expands reproducibility information: feature concatenation and the three-layer input MLP, concrete manual-exclusion examples, baseline output filenames and residue-extraction procedures, and AP pseudocode in Appendix K. These disclosures clarify existing procedures; the hardware, optimizer settings, and code/data access statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix C adds ProtDETR and distinguishes its enzyme-function classification task from binding-site detection. Appendix D explains baseline selection. The remaining research positioning and cited works are retained; the Dice-loss reference is reordered rather than newly added.

P1.justification: The main narrative and section sequence remain largely intact. v2 clarifies selected method and evaluation passages, expands and renames the conclusion, updates author and conference information, adds acknowledgements, and reorganizes the appendices around the supplementary additions.

P2.justification: v2 adds a curation workflow with structural case illustrations, dedicated double-counting, DCC-residue, and recall tables, and an AP algorithm display. Figure 3 is redrawn to distinguish the linear classification and MLP mask branches. Existing supplementary figures and tables are retained with relocation and renumbering.

improvement.justification: The new metric diagnostics and recall analyses strengthen empirical support for the evaluation argument, while curation examples, baseline-processing details, AP pseudocode, and explicit limitations improve transparency. These are useful, focused gains in validation and reporting; the new quantitative checks remain confined to HOLO4K-sc, and the original benchmark evidence is unchanged.
